This action came before the Court for a seven-day bench trial on March 13, 2017. The 
issues have been tried and the parties filed Proposed Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law on 
May 3, 2017 (D.I. 285 , 286). The court issued a Memorandum and Order ("Opinion ") on 
September 5, 2017 (D.I. 308 , 309). The court issued Judgment on September 5, 2017 (D.I . 310). 
Plaintiffs appealed the judgment to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit , 
which issued its opinion on August 27, 2019 and remanded for correction of the judgment to limit 
its ruling to the asserted claims before it. Therefore , 
IT IS HEREBY ORDERED AND ADJUDGED that final judgment is hereby entered in 
favor of defendants Praxair Distribution , Inc. , and Praxair , Inc . ("Defendants "), and against
